  • Deprecated Methods
    Method
    Description
    org.apache.lucene.index.MergePolicy.MergeSpecification.segString(Directory)
    Use MergePolicy.MergeSpecification.toString() instead. The Directory parameter is ignored and will be removed in a future release.
    org.apache.lucene.search.DocIdSet.all(int)
    no longer needed since Query and Filter were merged
    org.apache.lucene.search.DocIdSet.bits()
    this method is redundant and will be removed.
    org.apache.lucene.search.IndexSearcher.search(Query, Collector)
    This method is being deprecated in favor of IndexSearcher.search(Query, CollectorManager) due to its support for concurrency in IndexSearcher
    org.apache.lucene.search.SortField.getOptimizeSortWithIndexedData()
    org.apache.lucene.search.SortField.getOptimizeSortWithPoints()
    This is a duplicate method for SortField#getOptimizeSortWithIndexedData.
    org.apache.lucene.search.SortField.setMissingValue(Object)
    org.apache.lucene.search.SortField.setOptimizeSortWithIndexedData(boolean)
    should only be used for compatibility with 8.x indices that got created with inconsistent data across fields, or the wrong sort configuration in the index sort
    org.apache.lucene.search.SortField.setOptimizeSortWithPoints(boolean)
    should only be used for compatibility with 8.x indices that got created with inconsistent data across fields, or the wrong sort configuration in the index sort. This is a duplicate method for SortField#setOptimizeSortWithIndexedData.
    org.apache.lucene.store.DataInput.readGroupVInt(int[], int)
    This method is no longer called by Lucene. It is only kept for backwards compatibility. Code calling this method should migrate to GroupVIntUtil.readGroupVInts(DataInput, int[], int) to decode a full group including tails instead.
    org.apache.lucene.store.DataOutput.writeGroupVInts(long[], int)
    This method is preserved only for backwards codecs
    org.apache.lucene.util.automaton.Operations.concatenate(Automaton, Automaton)
    use Operations.concatenate(List) instead
    org.apache.lucene.util.automaton.Operations.union(Automaton, Automaton)
    use Operations.union(Collection) instead
    org.apache.lucene.util.BitDocIdSet.bits()
    org.apache.lucene.util.CharsRef.getUTF16SortedAsUTF8Comparator()
    This comparator is only a transition mechanism
    org.apache.lucene.util.CollectionUtil.newHashMap(int)
    Use HashMap.newHashMap directly.
    org.apache.lucene.util.CollectionUtil.newHashSet(int)
    Use HashMap.newHashMap directly.
    org.apache.lucene.util.GroupVIntUtil.readGroupVInt(DataInput, int[], int)
    Use GroupVIntUtil.readGroupVInts(DataInput, int[], int) to decode a full group including tails instead
    org.apache.lucene.util.GroupVIntUtil.readGroupVInt(DataInput, long[], int)
    Only for backwards codecs
    org.apache.lucene.util.GroupVIntUtil.readGroupVInt(DataInput, long, GroupVIntUtil.IntReader, long, int[], int)
    Don't call this method, it is no longer implemented. It was only provided for custom DataInput subclasses to allow to provide a faster GroupVInt encoding when random access is provided by the underlying storage. This is now obsolete, any implementation calling this should be removed in the calling class.
    org.apache.lucene.util.GroupVIntUtil.readGroupVInts(DataInput, long[], int)
    Only for backwards codecs
    org.apache.lucene.util.GroupVIntUtil.writeGroupVInts(DataOutput, byte[], long[], int)
